title: Connect Power BI Telemetry Apps to Read your Business Central Telemetry Data (2023)

chapters.title: Introduction to Power BI Telemetry Apps
Connecting Your Data to Power BI
Setting Time Zone and Refresh Period

features.name: Power BI Telemetry Apps for Business Central
features.description: Power BI apps for Business Central telemetry that display sample data initially and can be connected to read actual telemetry data from Azure Application Insights for environments or apps.

features.name: Data Connection Configuration for Power BI
features.description: A banner menu in Power BI that allows connecting telemetry apps to actual data by setting the Application Insights ID, time zone, and refresh period.
caveats: Most important setting is the Application Insights ID

features.name: API Access Menu for Application Insights ID
features.description: An API access menu under the configure section in Application Insights where the application ID GUID can be found and copied for use in Power BI configuration.

features.name: Time Zone Configuration for Reports
features.description: Ability to set the time zone for Power BI reports to match customer location, with example showing Copenhagen time zone setting.

features.name: Refresh Period Configuration
features.description: Setting the look-back period for Power BI report refreshes, with options for weekly, daily, or monthly refresh cycles that occur nightly.

features.name: OAuth Authentication for Application Insights
features.description: OAuth 2.0 authentication required to authorize Power BI reports to refresh by connecting to Application Insights using user credentials.
